'''Nuna drumsticks''' were a type of food made from [[Nuna/Legends|Nuna]] meat.

==History==
Nuna drumsticks were served onboard the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']]. It was a favorite of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]].
